# GuacaMol synthetic fixtures

Generated by `generate.py`. Commit these files; regenerate only if the dataset
schema changes.

## Files

| File | Records | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `valid.smiles` | 35 | Happy-path tests |
| `invalid.smiles` | 6 | Error-handling tests (malformed + semantically bad) |
| `empty.smiles` | 0 | Edge case: empty dataset |
| `large.smiles` | 1000 | Batch / performance tests |
| `metadata.json` | — | Schema fixture |

## Schema

Each `.smiles` line is a single SMILES string (no header, no ID column).
Blank lines are ignored by `_load_smiles_file`.
Invalid SMILES are skipped with a warning by `_label_smiles`.
